rebuttals.argument: The claim that Dunkin can allocate incremental labor within stated budgets targeting peak morning windows near Starbucks pilot cafés is not fully supported because Dunkin operates primarily through a franchise model where local labor and promotion budgets vary and are not centrally controlled. This limits the uniformity and scale of labor allocation assumed in the ruling.
